result.reason: The operative change reduces the non-renewal notice period to 30 days, satisfying the fallback requirement of no more than 60 days while retaining the 12-month automatic-renewal structure. It is a narrow change that preserves the original commercial framework. It does not fully achieve the preferred position because it adds no 60-day Vendor renewal reminder, but the stated CPI/3% cap in Section 8.3 is within both preferred and fallback limits. Drafting is professional, though expressly stating “notice of non-renewal” would be slightly clearer.
